description: Estimated time and cost savings per completed order (handoff, run, chat turn) and per implemented optimisation (software level), each against manual work (vergleich hand) and against classic software (klassische_software). Every row: minutes manual/control/classic, rates used (saetze_vorgabe = default 90 CHF/h, 960 CHF/day, not set by the tenant), measured AI cost in CHF (from token_usage x modell_preise) with its source, saved minutes/CHF, net CHF, begruendung, annahmen, sicherheit, modell, geschaetzt_am, quelle (ki|mensch), fassung. Latest version per order; auftrag_id returns the full history. Required: von, bis (YYYY-MM-DD, Europe/Zurich, the day the order ended). Optional: agent_id, ablauf, vergleich, auftrag_id, limit (default 100, max 500). Includes totals (which equal the sum of the rows). Admins, planners and agents. Read-only.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return
